changelog.name: Baseline v22.5
changes: The port now follows web v22.5, which stays frozen until the port is done (the web reference copy is web/dawgs_uprising_v22.5.html).
Balance from v22.4: the light tank fires the new heavy machine gun (weapon 'hmg'); its damage, fire rate and accuracy changed to match.
Web comparison recordings re-made from v22.5. v22.5 itself only changed camera controls, which the renderer port will pick up.
Tests run from the editor now stay open and show every result in their window (the Output panel could miss the last lines when the run quit straight away).

changelog.name: Skeleton
changes: Godot 4.7.2 project with the web version's split: sim/ (pure logic), render/ (battle view and HUD), menus/.
Every BALANCE number from web v22.3 is in data/balance.json.
The SIM runs a fixed 1/30 s step like the web game; the battle screen shows its clock. No units yet.
First SIM piece: the seeded random generator (sim/rng.gd), checked number-for-number against the web game. The tests compare the port with recordings of the web SIM in tests/golden/.
